summary: Universe: 4782 primes ≡1 (4) in (5,1e5] with witness sets W_p over the 16 family indicators (var_pr_1e5.txt). Greedy net for every threshold |W_p|≥1..6 is the single family '2 even' (exactly two even denominators), which misses 0 primes, while random size-1 portfolios miss ~1600 primes on average. Because the 2-adic lemma (exactly one even impossible; ES_CONNECTIONS_TODO l.2205, re-derived) makes that family's witness set the whole solution set, the net is trivial and reduces to 'p has a solution' (EVIDENCE to 1e5).

summary: Built the LSB-first base-2 carry (residual) automaton for 4xyz = p(xy+yz+zx) on [0,2^L)^3 for p=13,17 and L=3..8 by exact Myhill-Nerode residual counts per level. Max residual count per level grows 5,5,5,8,8,14 for L=3..8 (p=13) and 5,5,5,5,8,14 (p=17), so no L-independent width appears up to L=8 (CERTIFIED finite computation). The premise of bounded-width carry description is not supported for three-variable products.

summary: Exponent map for (xyz, xy, yz, zx) has a 1-dimensional kernel spanned by (-2,1,1,1), so the toric ideal is principal, generated by (xy)(yz)(zx) - (xyz)^2 (sympy, PROVED identity). The gcd substitution x=ga, y=gb, z=gc has the same kernel. The ES relation 4xyz - p(xy+yz+zx) is linear in the monomials and not binomial, so the toric structure carries no ES information.
